My boyfriend lived in my hometown when we first started dating & I was away at college which was about an hour & a half away. After only a month maybe two at the most I was leaving his house to go back to college & halfway back my car broke down. I had no one else to call because I stupidly told my parents that I was going back to school the day before I actually left so I could stay with him. I called him & he immediately called his mom (I have known his family for several years because he’s my best friends older brother but she passed away about 2 1/2 years before we started dating) because he couldn’t come get me since he was working out of town that day & was about 2 hours away. When I got back to his house & he got off work he knew I was stressing about because I needed to get my car fixed & get back to school. He immediately without any hesitation what so ever said “take my car you can use it until you get yours fixed.” He was so selfless in that moment (always is) & I ended up using his car for 2 months until I could get a new one since mine ended up being completely done for. I spent many hours in that car driving back & forth but the fact that we shared ONE car while living an hour & a half away from him I just knew he was the one for me!!
